weeks.content:
Completing missing numbers in addition and subtraction
sentences (e.g., 12 + = 20).

Identifying Nigerian coins and notes; counting, adding
and subtracting money.

Measuring objects using non-standard units (hand span,
sticks).

Measuring using standard units (metres, centimetres);
comparing lengths.

Reading time to the hour, half-hour, and quarter-hour on
clocks.

Measuring objects using standard units (grams,
kilograms); comparing weights.
Measuring liquids using standard units (litres, millilitres).

Identifying and drawing symmetrical shapes; folding to
find lines of symmetry.

Collecting data, representing data using pictograms,
interpreting simple pictographs.
